data.title: Activation of mTORC2 by association with the ribosome
data.authors: Zinzalla V; Hall MN et al.

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: mTORC2 is activated by direct association with the ribosome downstream of PI3K.
data.abstract_excerpt: The target of rapamycin (TOR) is a highly conserved protein kinase and a central controller of growth. Mammalian TOR complex 2 (mTORC2) regulates AGC kinase family members and is implicated in various disorders, including cancer and diabetes. Here, we investigated the upstream regulation of mTORC2. A genetic screen in yeast and subsequent studies in mammalian cells revealed that ribosomes, but not protein synthesis, are required for mTORC2 signaling.

extracted_findings.effect: mTORC2 is activated by direct association with the ribosome (PI3K-dependent)
